stories.title: Exclusion set + unprepared-candidate discovery
stories.description: Add the auto-seed candidate query (open issues WITHOUT status:ready-for-dev) and the exclusion filter. Reuse _PROMOTE_EXCLUSION_LABELS verbatim as the label veto and extend with Renovate/bot detection (label `dependencies` OR author `renovate[bot]`). This is the foundation both tier arms build on: it produces the filtered candidate list with each candidate's plan-tier classified.

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Unprepared issue is discovered as a candidate
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given an open issue with no `status:ready-for-dev` label
And it carries no exclusion label
When the auto-seed candidate query runs
Then the issue appears in the candidate list with its plan-tier classified

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Ready issue is not a candidate
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given an open issue already carrying `status:ready-for-dev`
When the auto-seed candidate query runs
Then the issue does NOT appear in the candidate list (it is _promote_labelled_ready's job)

Given an open issue without `status:ready-for-dev`
And it carries one of `triage` / `experimental` / `status:blocked` / `autonomous:halt` / `needs-human-review`
When the exclusion filter runs
Then the issue is excluded from auto-seed

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Renovate bot noise is vetoed by label
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given an open issue carrying the `dependencies` label
When the exclusion filter runs
Then the issue is excluded (e.g. the Dependency Dashboard #346 is never seeded)

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Renovate bot noise is vetoed by author backstop
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given an open issue authored by `renovate[bot]` with no `dependencies` label
When the exclusion filter runs
Then the issue is still excluded

stories.title: Light-tier auto-seed happy path (delegate to seed-issue)
stories.description: For a plan-tier:light new-work candidate with a rich body, dispatch seed-issue headlessly (MAKATO_HEADLESS=1 claude -p), which produces the label + spec folder + light-planner plan.md and promotes the card to Ready. On success the candidate is dispatchable in the same tick. Test hook MAKATO_LOOP_SEED_TEST_CMD stubs the claude -p spawn offline.

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Light plannable issue is auto-seeded and becomes dispatchable
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given a queued issue with `plan-tier:light` and no `status:ready-for-dev`
And its body is rich enough to plan against
When the loop reaches it
Then the loop headlessly seeds it (label + spec folder + light-planner plan.md)
And the issue is promoted to Ready and dispatched in the same tick — no manual seed-issue run required

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Seed dispatch uses the headless mechanism
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given a light plannable candidate
When auto-seed dispatches seed-issue
Then it spawns with MAKATO_HEADLESS=1 via the same claude -p mechanism cmd_dispatch uses

stories.title: Thin-body terminal state reconciliation
stories.description: When the light path's light-planner returns thin-body (no plan written; seed-issue's Step 8.5c re-tiered light→full and stripped status:ready-for-dev), the loop leaves the issue at Todo, ADDS needs-human-review (the label seed-issue's own fallback does not apply), and does NOT dispatch. The loop detects thin-body from seed-issue's orchestrate.jsonl light-plan line (data.thin_body / guard:invalid) with the post-seed label state as idempotent backstop.

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Thin-body light issue lands on needs-human-review, not dispatched
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given a `plan-tier:light` issue whose body is too thin
When light-planner refuses (thin-body)
Then no plan is written
And the issue stays at `Todo`
And `needs-human-review` is applied
And the loop does not dispatch it

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Thin-body issue is not re-seeded next tick
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given a thin-body issue already carrying `needs-human-review`
When the next auto-seed pass runs
Then the issue is excluded (needs-human-review is in the exclusion set) and not re-seeded

stories.title: Full / untiered arm — block for a human
stories.description: For a plan-tier:full or untiered candidate, do NOT dispatch. Pure-bash arm (no Claude spawn): prepare the spec folder, move the board card to Blocked, apply needs-human-review, and post a comment naming the exact full-makato-plan launch command. Comment guarded by a sentinel marker for idempotency (posts exactly once).

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Full-tier issue is blocked with a launch-command comment
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given a `plan-tier:full` issue with no `status:ready-for-dev`
When the loop reaches it
Then it is NOT dispatched
And the card moves to `Blocked`
And `needs-human-review` is applied
And a comment is posted naming the full-planning launch command

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Untiered issue is treated as full-tier
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given an open issue with no `plan-tier:*` label and no `status:ready-for-dev`
When the loop reaches it
Then it is blocked exactly like a `plan-tier:full` issue (Blocked + needs-human-review + launch-command comment), not dispatched

Given a full-tier issue already carrying the launch-command comment and `needs-human-review`
When the next auto-seed pass runs
Then no duplicate comment is posted and no duplicate label is added

stories.title: Tick integration, toggle, and offline smoke suite
stories.description: Wire _auto_seed_unprepared into cmd_run before _promote_labelled_ready (so a freshly-seeded light issue is same-tick dispatchable). Add cmd_auto_seed standalone entry point (mirrors cmd_promote_ready). Add the MAKATO_LOOP_AUTOSEED_ON_POLL toggle (default on) and all offline test hooks. Extend loop-smoke-tests.sh with scenarios Ta–Tk covering all four arms, best-effort, idempotency, toggle, and ordering. Update loop SKILL.md version, README env-var + pre-poll-pass docs, CHANGELOG.

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Auto-seed is best-effort — a failure never blocks the tick
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given the auto-seed pass encounters a `gh` or seed failure on a candidate
When the pass runs
Then it logs a WARN
And the tick continues (the pass returns success)

acceptanceTestCases.scenario: Auto-seed runs before promote-ready in the tick
acceptanceTestCases.gherkin:
Given a light plannable issue that auto-seed will promote to Ready
When a single `loop run --once` tick executes
Then auto-seed runs before _promote_labelled_ready
And the freshly-seeded issue is eligible for dispatch in the same tick

Given `MAKATO_LOOP_AUTOSEED_ON_POLL=0`
When a tick executes
Then the auto-seed pass performs no candidate query and no seed/block action
